description: Move, rename, or copy files and directories inside the roots. Use when you need to rename, relocate, or duplicate (copy: true). Do not use to change contents (`edit`, `patch`) or remove paths (`delete`). Missing parents are created. An existing destination asks to confirm; declining cancels the call, skipping drops that pair. Only copies can bypass the prompt (overwrite: true). A directory move never merges into a non-empty directory; a copy merges. Pairs that share a destination or overlap another pair fail; run dependent moves separately. Returns summary lines naming each pair and failure, and { moves: [{ from, to }], failures?, skipped?, undo id for `undo` (30 minutes) or undoUnavailable }; an error only if every pair failed.

copy.description: Copy and leave sources in place instead of moving

moves.description: Pairs run independently, with no rollback; a declined overwrite still cancels them all

destination.description: Full target path including the new name, not a parent folder

overwrite.description: Copy only: replace existing destinations without confirmation

name: move
title: Move or Copy Files
